## Solution

<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0058-length-of-last-word.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def lengthOfLastWord(self, s: str) -> int:
        li = s.split()
        n = len(li)
        return len(li[n-1])
```

</details>
